newsitem.title: USA: Liberty Property buys office buildings.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Property buys office buildings.

text.p: Liberty Property Trust said Wednesday it bought a 1.1 million square foot portfolio of office buildings in the suburban Detroit market of Oakland County, Mich. for $130.6 million.
Liberty said the portfolio consists of 13 properties which are 96 percent leased.
The company said it completed the acquisition of seven of the properties on June 23. Closing on the remaining six properties is scheduled for July 7.
Liberty said it expects to achieve an initial yield of 9.6 percent on the acquisition of the portfolio.
